{{quote|Hardened and studded. All the better for your kicking pleasure!|Item description}}
<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a quest item from the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It is given to the player by [[Krezvold]] for {{Money|5000}} after the {{item|Pile of Components|2}} are received from the [[Donkey]].

''Note: The {{Money|5000}} cost includes the [[Iron unicorn horns]] quest item as well.''

After giving it to the [[Donkey]] through the [[Contraband Box]] "Send: weapons" quest, along with the [[Iron unicorn horns]] the player will receive the [[Revolutionary message]] II.
